summary.interpretation: Describes robustness of an RGB-mask image-space proxy over a preregistered threshold grid and a VAE round-trip control. A positive result is not evidence of metric 3D scale change or physical object deformation.

limitations: The red RGB mask can include reflections and excludes darker parts of the ball.
Endpoint apparent-size change is image-space; depth and object pose are not measured.
The VAE round-trip sequence is a decoder-path control, not independent geometry ground truth.
The RGB threshold-grid pass rule is descriptive and does not establish statistical significance.
